compile_pilot.charge_scope: pace/acquisition prefix after the third matched pair
compile_pilot.gate: Two-instance pilot gate, not the main paper four-of-five admission gate.
compile_pilot.training_success_rule: Keep all first three completed agent traces, including failure outcomes.
compile_pilot.trigger: Prescheduled guard validation, not the PACE projected compilation trigger.

scope.failure_rule: No retries. Unknown billing stops all paid work, keeps worst-case reservation and every artifact. Parsing failure terminates task. GUI action error is observed by next call, until fixed 20-call cap.
scope.reference: Supplied per-arrival billing allowance, not measured agent-only bill or estimated true upper bound.
scope.role: Deployment components plus a single cold-build pilot after three live agent traces. Fixed existing deployment program; no full online selection claim.
